First impressions are everything. When guests arrive at our hotels, we want that impression to be memorable. The same goes for departures. When guests leave, we want them to go with a smile and a feeling that we were there for them throughout their stay. We want to build an experience that is memorable and unique from start to finish. Our Guest Arrival Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their arrival and departure experiences. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Arrival Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Arrival Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing more than 75 pounds with assistance.. Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Arrival Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

d: We are looking for an experienced Regulatory Affairs Specialist to manage product registrations, regulatory approvals, and compliance requirements for our nutrition, dietary supplements, vitamins, and sports nutrition products in Qatar.
The ideal candidate should have practical knowledge of Qatar's regulatory procedures, government authorities, product registration systems, and import requirements.
q: Previous experience in Regulatory Affairs, preferably within the pharmaceutical, healthcare, dietary supplements, or food industry.
Practical knowledge of Qatar's product registration and regulatory approval procedures.
Experience dealing with Qatar Ministry of Public Health (MOPH) and relevant authorities.
Knowledge of product labeling, ingredient assessment, and import regulations.
Strong documentation, coordination, and communication skills.
Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage.
Candidates currently residing in Qatar are preferred.
r: Manage the registration and approval of dietary supplements, vitamins, sports nutrition products, and other health-related products in Qatar.
Coordinate with relevant Qatari regulatory authorities, including the Ministry of Public Health (MOPH).
Prepare, review, and submit product registration applications and supporting documentation.
Ensure all products comply with Qatar's applicable laws, regulations, and labeling requirements.
Review product labels, ingredients, certificates of analysis (COA), Free Sale Certificates, and other technical documents.
Handle import permits, product clearances, and regulatory approvals when required.
Monitor changes in Qatar's regulatory requirements and ensure ongoing compliance.
Manage product registration renewals and maintain accurate regulatory records.
Coordinate with suppliers, manufacturers, internal departments, and government authorities.
Resolve regulatory issues and follow up on pending applications and approvals.
